item.title: 2012 'Regular Show' Episode Inspires Viral Reddit Meme About Character Weaknesses
item.description: Dude, You're Allergic to Eggs or Dude, You're Weak to X is an exploitable image macro meme format based on a scene from Regular Show where Rigby gets taken away in an ambulance after eating an omelet, Mordecai saying to Rigby, "Dude, you're allergic to eggs?" and Rigby answering, "I thought if I ate really fast, maybe I wouldn't notice." item.title: Why Are TikTok Users Dripped Out in Israeli Flags? New Viral Trend Explained
item.description: Israel Drip refers to a TikTok meme in which users post AI-generated images of themselves wearing outfits adorned with Israeli flags and portraits of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The trend represents a shift towards an ironic reverence for Israel and its Prime Minister following a period of outright derision.

item.title: Viral December 2025 'The Destiny Of Marge' Video Becomes An Unexpected Meme On TikTok

item.title: Resurfaced Fitness Clip Becomes The Perfect Reaction Video: Get 'Em Banned Meme Explained
item.description: Get 'Em Banned refers to a viral video turned reaction video featuring former Peloton instructor Kendall Toole requesting that a user be banned for misconduct. Following the virality of the video, the phrase "Get 'em banned. We don't do that here" has since been adopted as popular slang used on X/Twitter.
